problems.quote: Three points A, B, C with position vectors a, b, c are collinear (lie on the same line) if one vector can be written as a linear combination of the other two.
problems.problem: The condition 'one vector can be written as a linear combination of the other two' is not equivalent to collinearity; any vector in the span of two vectors satisfies this, but collinearity requires an affine combination (coefficients summing to 1).
problems.correction: Three points A, B, C with position vectors a, b, c are collinear if one vector can be written as an affine combination of the other two (coefficients sum to 1).
problems.verifierReason: Original misses affine condition; correction correctly states coefficients sum to 1.
